permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description:
Administrators always have access (file deletion still needs an administrator's approval). Everything below is off until you enable it.

**Trusted voice devices:** trusting an Assist satellite authorizes anyone who can speak to it. This is not speaker verification. Voice access never approves file deletion.

search_torrents.name: Search torrents
search_torrents.description: Search Jackett by title. Returns a stored, numbered result list; downloads nothing.

query.name: Title
query.description: Title to search for, e.g. Dune.

terms.name: Release terms
terms.description: Optional terms such as 1080p or German.

get_search_results.name: Get search results
get_search_results.description: Show more results of a stored search without searching again.

preview_torrent.name: Preview torrent
preview_torrent.description: Select one stored result and check it can be added. Starts no download.

result_id.name: Result ID
result_id.description: ID of the result. Use this or the position.

position.name: Position
position.description: 1-based position in the stored list. Use this or the result ID.

add_torrent.name: Add torrent
add_torrent.description: Download a previewed result to a configured destination.

subfolder.name: Subfolder
subfolder.description: Optional relative folder below the destination.

show_name.name: Show name
show_name.description: TV: show title, used to plan the folder.

show_year.name: Show year
show_year.description: TV: premiere year of the series.

list_torrents.name: List torrents
list_torrents.description: List qBittorrent torrents with progress and state.

query.name: Name filter
query.description: Only torrents whose name contains this text.

get_torrent.name: Get torrent
get_torrent.description: Show one torrent by exact hash.

pause_torrent.name: Pause torrent
pause_torrent.description: Pause one torrent by exact hash.

resume_torrent.name: Resume torrent
resume_torrent.description: Resume one torrent by exact hash.

remove_torrent.name: Remove torrent (keep files)
remove_torrent.description: Remove a torrent job; downloaded files are kept.

request_file_deletion.name: Request file deletion
request_file_deletion.description: Ask for deletion of a torrent and its files. An administrator must approve in Home Assistant.
